pairs.fix: Put the caravan on a smooth, plain green ground with no grass tufts. Use a backdrop of soft light rays or a smooth gradient instead of rings.

pattern: Generated cards fill the background with many small, separate things: extra buildings, fences, barns and furniture, plus scattered decoration such as confetti, petals, water droplets, hay strands and grass tufts. The floor is often busy with texture. Real cards use a few large, quiet shapes and a tone-on-tone backdrop, they crop the scene close, and they add no props beyond what the subject names.
